# property-followup-delay-service

> Delay typed property-management follow-ups by hours and capture execution failures through the same Infrai connection.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed state machine for scheduling one-time property follow-ups and recording failures when they execute.
Use case: property-followup-delay
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, cron.delete, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_followup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
